verdict.rationale: treg is a token-authenticated HTTP API: one base URL and one token give access to 159 operations plus the `/call/` proxy. A live OpenAPI spec is published and the CLI installs with a one-line curl script, so non-interactive, scripted use is the product's core mode. The docs never address CI pipelines directly, and the documented sign-in paths (GitHub, emailed OTP, invite code) look interactive. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (e.g. CI examples, non-interactive CLI auth via env-var token or service accounts), independent hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.
